meta.title: Relief Corridor KESTREL
meta.subtitle: Choose a route while the picture dissolves
meta.summary: A relief convoy must pick the north pass or the south ford while interference delays, drops, and contradicts the reports that describe both routes.
briefing: Convoy KESTREL-1 is staged at Camp Alder with time-critical relief supplies for Distribution Point Marigold. A weather window closes at 30:00 scenario time.

Two routes exist. The north route through Veer Pass is short and pays off most, but a blocked pass would strand the convoy. The south route through Tamsa Ford is longer and pays off less, but is usually passable.
Four information sources feed you: land patrols, aerial survey, sensor telemetry, and spectrum monitoring. Expect delays, gaps, and contradictions.
You may task one verification asset per route. Verification takes time and costs resources. Waiting also costs: every minute after 12:00 reduces the value of moving at all.
This is a synthetic training scenario. Entities, reliabilities, and payoffs are authoring assumptions and do not represent any real operation or doctrine.

reports.claim: Checkpoint Alder: Veer Pass road open, no obstruction
reports.detail: Ground patrol reports the road surface at the Veer Pass entrance is clear and traffic is moving normally.

reports.claim: Aerial survey: Veer Pass visible and clear
reports.detail: Survey flight over the northern corridor shows no debris on the pass road. Imagery resolution is adequate.

reports.claim: Tamsa Ford crossing passable, water level normal
reports.detail: Patrol crossed the ford this morning without difficulty. Water level is within the normal range.

reports.claim: Pass sensor mesh: all nodes nominal
reports.detail: Roadside vibration and tilt sensors report nominal readings. Sensors can fail silently, so this is weaker evidence than direct observation.

reports.claim: Wideband interference detected near Veer Pass
reports.detail: Spectrum monitoring detects wideband interference in the pass vicinity. Land and aerial links may be degraded or delayed.

reports.claim: Pass sensor mesh: telemetry frozen, integrity flag raised
reports.detail: Several sensor nodes report identical readings for four minutes. Frozen telemetry can indicate sensor failure, tampering, or physical damage to the node.

reports.claim: Patrol: rockfall observed near Veer Pass entrance
reports.detail: A patrol vehicle saw fresh rockfall near the pass entrance and turned back before reaching it. The report was queued while the link was degraded.

reports.claim: Aerial survey: debris field across Veer Pass road
reports.detail: Survey imagery shows a debris field blocking the road at the pass entrance.

reports.claim: Patrol: Tamsa Ford water level rising
reports.detail: Upstream rain is raising the water level at the ford. Crossing remains possible but margins are shrinking.

reports.claim: Aerial relay: pass appears clear (partial imagery, cloud cover)
reports.detail: Link restored. Imagery is partly obscured by cloud; the visible sections of the pass road look clear. Coverage of the pass entrance is incomplete.

reports.claim: Checkpoint Alder: debris confirmed covering Veer Pass road
reports.detail: Direct confirmation from the patrol that reached the entrance. Delivered late because of link delay.

events.note: Wideband interference on the patrol net: messages delayed
Aerial relay link lost: messages not delivered

resultClaims.contradicts: Sortie confirms Veer Pass blocked by debris

resultClaims.supports: Gauge check confirms Tamsa Ford passable
resultClaims.contradicts: Gauge check confirms Tamsa Ford impassable

decisionPoints.title: Select the convoy route
decisionPoints.prompt: Commit KESTREL-1 to a route, or stand down. The window closes at 30:00.

actions.label: Take the north route (Veer Pass)
actions.description: Short route. High payoff if passable; convoy stranded if blocked.

consequences.headline: Convoy clears Veer Pass
consequences.narrative: KESTREL-1 passes the pass without incident and reaches Marigold inside the window.

consequences.headline: Convoy halted at the Veer Pass debris field
consequences.narrative: KESTREL-1 stops at the debris field. Recovery and re-routing exhaust the weather window.

actions.label: Take the south route (Tamsa Ford)
actions.description: Long route. Moderate payoff if passable; convoy stranded if impassable.

consequences.headline: Convoy crosses Tamsa Ford
consequences.narrative: KESTREL-1 crosses the ford with reduced margin and reaches Marigold inside the window.

consequences.headline: Convoy halted at Tamsa Ford
consequences.narrative: Rising water prevents the crossing and the weather window is lost.

actions.label: Stand down at Camp Alder
actions.description: Hold the convoy. Safe, but the mission is deferred.

consequences.headline: Convoy holds at Camp Alder
consequences.narrative: KESTREL-1 stays in place and the relief delivery is deferred to the next window.

injectPresets.label: Jam LAND link
injectPresets.description: Delay land patrol reports by 6 minutes for 10 minutes

injectPresets.label: Drop AIR link
injectPresets.description: Drop all aerial reports for 6 minutes

injectPresets.label: Degrade CYBER telemetry
injectPresets.description: Halve the effective reliability of sensor telemetry for 8 minutes

injectPresets.label: Inject conflicting report
injectPresets.description: Insert an unconfirmed relay claiming Veer Pass is clear

effect.claim: Patrol relay: Veer Pass reported clear (unconfirmed)
effect.detail: Second-hand relay of an earlier observation; origin unclear.
